QuestInfo.name: Honor of the Cygnus Knights
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1101002##k, the tactician of #b#m130000000##k, has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# wants you to represent the Cygnus Knights in #bBattle Mode#k. Aim for #bRank 9#k to do honor to the Empress. Talk to #b#p9070004##k in any city to join Battle Mode.
QuestInfo.2: #p1101002# congratulated you for reaching Rank 9. Bring more honor to Cygnus by achieving higher ranks!

0.0: Greetings, #h0#. I have heard rumors of great concerns to the Cygnus Knights. It appears that #bBattle Mode#k has opened in Maple World.
0.1: Battle Mode is where the greatest warriors of Maple World come together to test their strength. If the Cygnus Knights do not make a show of strength, the Empress will become the laughing stock of all the lands.
0.2: Hence, I'm asking all of our knights to represent Cygnus in Battle Mode. I expect great things from you in particular, and would like you to reach #bRank 9#k. I am confident you will bring even greater renown to our beloved Empress.

yes.0: They say that you can participate in Battle Mode by talking to #b#p9070004# in any town#k. Remember, your goal is Rank 9.

no.0: Hmm... Perhaps my faith was misplaced. I see now how weak and feeble you are.

1.0: You've reached Rank 9. Well done. The Empress is pleased with you.

yes.0: Continue to fight, and win, in the name of Cygnus. As your rank increases, so does the Empress's renown.

default.0: It appears you haven't reached #bRank 9#k in #bBattle Mode#k yet... Is this your best? Are you sure? Please go see #b#p9070004# in any town#k.
